messages:
sarah_sales: Quick ask — Acme wants a perf POC next week. Target load: 20k req/min (burst to 30k), ~3k concurrent, avg prompt 200–250 tokens, responses up to 512 tokens. p95 latency target <350ms. Need a runbook, cost estimate, and infra config. They prefer US-WEST. Timeline: Tue/Wed preferred.
dan_se: Quick clarifying Qs — which model variant are we testing (full-size or distilled)? quantized allowed? also do they need streaming?
perf_mike: Plan: two lanes. lane A = baseline (full model, fp16) on dedicated A100s. lane B = quantized path (4-bit / q4) on cheaper GPUs. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, end-to-end latency including network, success rate, and model degradation. Warm-up 5m, steady test 15m per step. Will capture cold-starts.
alice_acme: Confirming US-WEST only. We can provide VPC peering + test dataset. NDA signed but security questionnaire still pending. Also: can you simulate realistic user think-times?
marta_security: We can provide KMS flow + audit log doc. For VPC peering we need a contact from your infra — also require private endpoint for the POC (per our compliance). @alice_acme please share the questionnaire items we should pre-fill.
perf_mike: k6 + a small streaming harness is the plan. Example k6 invocation we’ll use to drive sustained load: ```bash
k6 run --vus 3000 --duration 15m 
  -e ENDPOINT=https://private.redwood-acme/v1/generate 
  -e PAYLOAD_FILE=sample_prompts.json 
  script.js
``` We'll also run short high-burst phases (1m) at 30k rpm to exercise autoscale.
sarah_sales: Good. Also need a clear price delta for baseline vs quantized path for procurement. Can you ballpark?
dan_se: Very rough estimate: baseline hosted/dedicated POC ~ $7k/day at target load; quantized path ~ $2.5k/day. Will produce detailed line items (GPU hours, network egress, token units) after test config locked.
perf_mike: Note on SLOs — if they want p95 <350ms for 512 token outputs, we’ll need aggressive batching + prewarmed instances. We'll include an additional lane with KV/prefix cache enabled to show best-case latency.
deploy-bot: dedicated cluster created: ded-acme-poc-2026 (8x A100-80GB), private endpoint ready in us-west-2.
alice_acme: Thanks — confirming Thurs 10:00am PT for the main run (our infra folks available). We will provide sample prompts and 3 test accounts. Please include cold-start numbers and failover to smaller model behavior.
perf_mike: Confirmed Thurs 10am PT. Test checklist: 1) Provisioned cluster (done) 2) VPC peering + private endpoint 3) sample prompts uploaded 4) monitoring dashboards ready 5) cost meter enabled. I'll upload raw traces + charts to S3 and share link.
marta_security: We'll attach a short writeup on data handling and KMS integration for their security team.
sarah_sales: Perfect. Mike — can you DM me the final doc + a one-page summary for procurement before EOD Monday? I'll send to Acme.
perf_mike: Will do. After the run I'll produce: CSV of latencies, token counts, instance metrics, and a short recommendations section (autoscale thresholds, batch sizes, quantization tradeoffs).
alice_acme: One more thing — please include an explicit fallback test where throughput drops and system routes to a cheaper model (for degraded mode). That’s a must for our architects.
perf_mike: Added degraded-fallback lane to the plan. We'll record seamlessly switched latency and cost numbers.
dan_se: Thx everyone. I'll also prep a pricing appendix showing monthly extrapolation for their projected traffic.
sarah_sales: Awesome. I’ll coordinate calendar invites and forward procurement contacts. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: test-run scheduled: 1761003600 (Thu 10:00am PT). Logs and dashboards will be available at /s3/redwood/acme-poc/1761000000/
perf_mike: Final note — expect the initial results snapshot within 2 hours of test end. Full writeup same day.
